findingsRefined.title: Packet completion status contradicts active phase records
findingsRefined.reason: Phase 2 AC-014 is explicitly Unmet and the child acceptance contract says this blocks closure.

findingDetails.title: Packet completion status contradicts active phase records
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile the parent status, goal completion checks, and child phase acceptance state; the parent must not say Complete while a required child criterion remains Unmet.
findingDetails.claim: The root spec and goal claim completion while phase 2 remains In progress and its closure criterion AC-014 is Unmet; the child acceptance contract says any row outside Met, Waived, or Superseded prevents closure.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Phase 5's acceptance checklist and evidence are complete, but that does not satisfy phase 2 AC-014 or the phase 2 closure contract.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The parent and goal may have stale completion marks while later phases were completed from an earlier state; the explicit unmet child criterion still controls phase 2 closure.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade only if phase 2 AC-014 is changed to a met state with evidence and the parent status is reconciled.

findingDetails.title: Staged type-change paths bypass the local-skill guard
findingDetails.recommendation: Include type-change entries in the staged-path scan or inspect all changed index paths before applying the private-path guard.
findingDetails.claim: The pre-commit hook's ACMR filter omits Git type-change status T before applying the local-* path regex.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A fresh untracked local-* path is reported as added and caught; the gap is limited to a type change at an already tracked local-* path.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Keep at P2 unless a reachable tracked local-* path is shown to carry private payload through the omitted T status.
